text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "The primary colour changed from brand blue #1E4D8C to teal #0F766E on 15 Jun; a design cannot have both as its single primary colour."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Paying for CircleCI has nothing to do with the primary colour; both remain true."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus being the PM is unaffected by a colour change; both remain true."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The number of shipping lanes is independent of the primary colour; both remain true."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Sarah's departure is a past event and has no bearing on the primary colour."}]}
